name: Heavy Waves Crashing Against Rocky Cliff - Low-End Impacts and Splashes (AB Stereo)
description: Powerful field recording of giant waves crashing against a rocky cliff on a windy day. The recording captures the deep, subterranean-like booming of waves, sudden explosive impacts against the rocks, and the sound of spray reaching close to the recorder. Recorded on a rocky outcrop at Playa San Antonio de Regatas, Peru, using Micverve's PrimoEM272Z1 pair to a ZoomF6 in an AB (35cm) spaced stereo.
